title: 3 Day Banff Moraine Lake Louise Johnston Columbia Icefield Tour
includes: In winter, icewalk crampons will be provided and use at your own responsibility

blurb:
Join this remarkable 3-day journey to discover the majestic beauty of the Canadian Rockies. 

Begin by exploring iconic destinations like Banff, Lake Louise, and Moraine Lake, where the stunning turquoise waters and towering peaks will leave you mesmerized. 

Traverse the scenic Icefields Parkway, where breathtaking views unfold at every turn. Marvel at the awe-inspiring Columbia Icefields, where you can even step foot on a glacier and experience its icy wonder up close. 

Your journey promises a seamless exploration of this spectacular natural wonderland from start to finish.
